author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
In Command Override, players take control like never before.  

Hack robots, pilot them remotely and see through their eyes as you explore RobCo’s new Boston headquarters and uncover the secrets of Project Ghost Pilot.   

Discover new gear, build a personal robot defense squad, and take on a Gunner threat led by the formidable General Hayes.  

Features: 
- Build your own personal army of up to 4 hacked robots that will defend you at all costs.  
- Access the Assaultron’s eye laser and the Sentry Bots miniguns in combat. 
- Find new weapons and gear, including the Ghost Pilot suit. 
- Discover the experimental Beam gun. An all-new weapon type that fires a continuous laser beam projectile and sets enemies ablaze when it overheats. 

Command Override is available for PC, XBOX, and PlayStation via the Creations menu. 

ESRB RATING: Mature with Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Strong Language, and Use of Drugs

author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
The World Pets update arrives December 1. Never roam alone again. Choose the perfect pet, give them a name, customize their appearance, and set out with a loyal friend by your side. From faithful Dogs and Cats to fearsome Radhogs and even a mighty Deathclaw. Direct your companion with attack, defend, and follow commands, level them into a powerful ally, and unlock unique perks that complement your playstyle as you carve your legend across the wasteland together.
